Black Friday is officially upon us, and streaming deals are rolling out one by one. HBO Max is the latest subscription to drop its big discount of the year, though unfortunately, it locks you into the plan with ads.
From now until November 30 (Cyber Monday), both new and returning subscribers can sign up for 12 months of HBO Max Basic at the discounted rate of $5.49/month . The subscription normally costs $10.99, offering a savings of 50% each month.
While this is by far the best way to save on HBO Max over the next 12 months, it’s a noticeably worse deal than last year’s $2.99/month offer for the same ad-supported subscription.
HBO Max Drops Black Friday Streaming Deal
The HBO Max Black Friday deal only applies to the streaming service’s ad-supported Basic plan , which allows for simultaneous streaming on up to two devices. The Standard plan, which removes ads, and the Premium plan, which adds 4K support, are still at full price.
You can get the 50% discount directly through HBO Max or through Prime Video's HBO Max add-on . While Amazon already launched its own Black Friday sale , we’re unfortunately not seeing any discounts on Prime Video itself.
Paramount+ also launched its Black Friday deal , which is limited to two months. I’m honestly surprised HBO Max is offering a full year of discounts.
The two services, now joined under the Skydance banner , are launching a joint bundle in early 2027. I assumed the new Warner Bros. owner was aiming to set deal subscribers up to roll over to the new offering, but it seems HBO Max is still doing its own thing. I take that as a win.
The future of Warner Bros. may be a little uncertain, but boy does it's past offer one of the best streaming libraries. HBO Max, naturally, gets you access to some all-time HBO greats like The Wire, The Sopranos, and Mad Men.
Outside of its own programming, HBO Max is home to all things Adult Swim, A24, and whatever ends up happening with the DC universe. If You Can See Everything piqued your interest in Nathan Fielder, HBO Max is also where you can catch up on Nathan for You and The Rehearsal.
More Streaming Deals Are on the Way Crunchyroll and Paramount+ are the other big streaming deals we’ve seen so far, but I expect the rest of the usual slate to roll out deals over the course of this week. Except Netflix, never expect deals from Netflix.

pool.titulo: The Secret Controls GTA 6 Doesn't Tell You About — How To Flip Your Car, Flip the Bird, and Much More
pool.resumen: GTA 6 has a whole bunch of secret controls that the game doesn't really tell you about. Here's how to flip your car, flip the bird, and much more.
pool.contenido:
There are many, many new things you can do in GTA 6 compared with the rest of the Grand Theft Auto series, and many of them have dedicated controls. One of the most obvious is the switching of sprint to L3 by default, which is explained on a menu screen before you even set foot in Leonida. Others, though, are revealed to you later in the story, or, in some cases, not outright communicated to you at all.
From how to flip your car if you end up overturning it to how you can keep the engine running outside a robbery target, here are 23 secret buttons Rockstar doesn’t tell you about in GTA 6.
Vehicle Controls 1. Leaving the Car Engine Running – Want to make a quick getaway from the scene of a crime? You can leave your car’s engine purring away while you’re robbing somewhere by double-tapping the triangle/Y button on your controller when you exit the vehicle.
2. Leaving the Boat Engine Running – If you do the same thing while in a boat — double-tap the triangle/Y button — you can then freely walk around it while it continues to sail in a straight line. Use that opportunity to change into scuba gear, or shoot at nearby people if you wish.
3. Auto Drive – Want to sit back and enjoy the scenery? You can switch into cinematic camera mode and Jason or Lucia will drive to your chosen destination without you having to do a thing, much like how Red Dead Redemption 2 lets you do something similar with your horse. Hold down on the D-pad and press the options/menu button. Once in cinematic view, hold circle/B.
4. Vehicle Options – Want to manually access the options of your chosen vehicle? Open the radio menu by holding left on the D-pad, then flick the right stick to turn on your headlights, roll down the windows, or fold down the convertible roof, if your car has one. This also applies to other vehicles, such as lowering the anchor on a boat.
5. Flip Your Car – Got yourself into a little bit of bother on the tight streets of Vice City? If you happen to overturn your car completely, hit L3/LS and then hold square/X to get back onto four wheels.
6. Push Jet Ski Back Into Water – Accidentally beach your jet ski, or find one sitting on the sand that you want to get back into the ocean? Walk behind it and hold R1/RB to push it back into the water.
7. Use Your Door as a Weapon – Want to smack anyone who happens to be a little too close to your car? Tap square/X while seated inside to hit them with your door. This also works when cycling, but causes Jason or Lucia to kick out with force.
8. Get Low and Hide – Sometimes avoiding trouble is the best method, though. Avoid anyone looking for you, such as the police, by holding circle/B when sitting in the driver’s seat . Your character will then duck low to remain hidden.
9. Turn Signals – Want to fully immerse yourself when behind the wheel in GTA 6 and follow the code of the road? Tap left or right on the D-pad while driving to indicate using your turn signals.
10. Road Rage – Fancy hurling a volley of verbal abuse at a nearby driver? Yell out of the window by pressing R3/RS while driving .
11. Quick Radio Toggle – A quick double-tap of left on the D-pad when driving can swiftly switch the radio on or off if you want to make sure you hear a certain piece of dialogue, for example.
12. Hand Over the Wheel – Sometimes you just want to sit back and let your partner drive. GTA 6 lets you do this by standing near a car while playing as both Jason and Lucia together, and holding right on the D-pad and selecting cross/A .
13. Pop a Wheelie – This is one you’ve been able to do in many GTA games of the past, but it's still something that Rockstar doesn’t teach you here. Pull back on the left stick while accelerating to pop a wheelie, or push forward to perform a stoppie.
On Foot 14. Car Hood Slide – There are uses for your car outside of it getting you from point A to B. It can also make you look pretty cool when on foot. Sprint and then hit cross/A when approaching a car hood to slide across it smoothly.
15. Combat Roll – If you want to go full action movie hero/heroine, then combat rolls are a necessity. Push the left stick in a direction of your choosing and hit cross/A while aiming to evade in style. Note: looks even cooler in focus mode.
16. Take a Rest – Sometimes a break from all the action is needed, though. Lean on a wall or railing by pressing R3/RS or sit on chairs or the end of a jetty by holding circle/B.
17. First-Person – Inspect Mode lets you see the world through Jason and Lucia’s eyes. While you can’t move around or drive cars from this perspective, it does let you see some of GTA 6’s details more clearly and help you find clues such as safe combinations. Hold the left trigger and then press the right stick to take a closer look.
18. Aim Down Sights – If you hit R3/RS while aiming with a gun , though, you will be able to aim down sights. This only happens if your weapon is equipped with a suitable optic, however.
19. Switch Shoulder – When aiming a weapon, you can choose which shoulder Jason or Lucia is firing from by hitting left on the D-pad .
20. Chokehold – Find yourself in a fist fight? There are plenty more ways of ending it available to you than hammering the punch button. Grapple with R2 and then hold in square/X before pressing the same button repeatedly to choke your opponent out.
21. Flip the Bird – Nothing beats the classics. Make sure you have no weapon equipped, target an NPC with the left trigger, and then hold in R1 to raise a middle finger towards them.
22. Flick the Cigarette – Another way to annoy the population of Leonida is to flick a lit cigarette into their face. Midway through smoking one, hold the left trigger and then pull the right trigger to dash the burning tobacco at them.

pool.titulo: Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Goes Heavy on Steve Rogers, as Marvel Keeps Big Reveals Under Wraps
pool.resumen: Marvel has released a major new Avengers: Doomsday trailer showing our best look at the film yet, though the studio is seemingly keeping some of its big cards close to its chest.
pool.contenido:
Marvel has released a major new Avengers: Doomsday trailer showing our best look at the film yet, though the studio is seemingly keeping some of its big cards close to its chest.
The footage runs to more than three minutes, making the clip a sizable look compared to the glimpses teased so far. Still, there seems to be much here that Marvel is still keeping under wraps with just a couple of weeks left to go until Doomsday's December launch.
"We made a choice that we knew was right," Steve Rogers says to Peggy Carter, discussing what they have told their new son. "Why does it feel so wrong to lie to him? How's he ever going to know who we are unless we tell him?" Today's trailer focuses heavily on Steve, Peggy and their son — who we now see as a child for the first time, rather than just as a newborn baby.
"Steven Grant Rogers," Carter replies, "Do you think that boy doesn't know who you are? Every time you walk him to school or kiss him good night, do you think for an instant he doesn't know you?"
After a montage of clips showing Rogers bonding with his boy, who should turn up but... The Fantastic Four. "Are you Steve Rogers?" asks Reed Richards. Yes, yes he is. And it's here that Steve's son finally discovers his dad is a superhero, and Steve handily recounts how the Avengers saved the universe back in Endgame, via a bit of time travel shenanigans.
As fans had expected, the trailer confirms that Doctor Doom is now on the warpath as a result of those shenanigans — and it's not just the Rogers family who are at risk. Thor and Ant-Man are seen with their daughters in clips we've seen previously, while Hawkeye-in-training Kate Bishop is also glimpsed for the first time. ( Hailee Steinfeld finally confirmed her inclusion within the film just this weekend .)
As Thor and Steve Rogers give rousing speeches, we see the leadup to what looks like the Avengers' first proper encounter with Doom and the Sentinels, with the X-Men now on-side too. We get to see Bucky reunite with Steve, and Cyclops gets to call the X-Men to him for an epic Avengers-style panning shot (that actually leaked online earlier this year). Finally, Thor teases Rogers about his speech, saying it was "average by Cap standards" — yet more Sam Wilson erasure!
Fans had expected today's trailer to drop around now , thanks to the loose lips of Peggy Carter actress Hayley Atwell (and we also now have a good idea of how long the final film will last). But while today's trailer filled in a few blanks from Doomsday's first act, there's no shock reveal here for later in the film, or confirmation of any character we didn't already know to be included. Some fans had speculated this was when we'd finally see Deadpool and Wolverine confirmed, after several teases over the summer. And the shot of three cloaked Latverian witches will further drive speculation as to their identities — especially in the wake of VisionQuest's ending featuring the return of Elizabeth Olsen . (Are the witches Wanda, Clea and Sylvie?)
For answers to that and what happens next as the multiverse's mightiest surviving heroes fight Doctor Doom, you'll just have to head along to the theater. Avengers: Doomsday launches on December 18.

pool.titulo: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Amid Donald Trump Social Media Pressure
pool.resumen: The Nvidia board has reinstated Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director amid social media pressure from Donald Trump.
pool.contenido:
The Nvidia board has reinstated Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director amid social media pressure from Donald Trump.
Huang — who stepped down as Nvidia CEO amid a scandal involving infidelity and alleged espionage — rejoins the company after its Board of Directors “voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead Nvidia."
Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on November 12 after reports of an affair with a woman U.S. officials suspect of working for Chinese intelligence. The suspicion has not been proven, and Huang has not been accused of criminal wrongdoing.
"In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk," Nvidia continued.
Last week, Huang said he was ready to return to the company he co-founded , while apologizing for the problems he'd caused both Nvidia and his family. In a statement issued at the time, Huang insisted he would be willing to return as CEO if Nvidia's Board of Directors decided it was in the best interest in the company. Some Nvidia employees and other tech CEOs had rallied to Huang's defense and called for him to be reinstated as CEO.
Nvidia's dramatic decision comes just hours after President Donald Trump called for Huang's reinstatement in a post on Truth Social. Trump said Huang's return would be best for both the company and the United States.
Harvey C. Jones, Chair of the Board, issued the following statement:
“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers. We have every confidence in Jensen and look forward to working with him as he resumes his leadership of the Company. We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as Nvidia's Chief Financial Officer.”
Jensen Huang issued a statement of his own:
“I am honored to return to Nvidia and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution. I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the Nvidia Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process. I am especially grateful to Harvey Jones for his leadership as Chair, and to Colette Kress and our executive staff for leading Nvidia during this period. I am also deeply thankful to our employees, shareholders, leaders across the industry and partners around the world for their extraordinary support. Above all, I am grateful for the love and support of my family. I can’t wait to get back to work.”
Nvidia said today that it had formed a committee to investigate reports that Huang had been the target of a " foreign intelligence effort," and insisted the investigation will proceed. "Mr. Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it," Nvidia said.
Nvidia and Huang still face tough questions about who was in charge of compliance at the company, as well as answers to reports of chip sales to China. Meanwhile, Nvidia said it had formed a National Security and Export Control Committee to oversee trade compliance and national security risks. Nvidia is on the hunt for a Chief Compliance Officer to oversee compliance across Nvidia and report to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. "Nvidia will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries," it said.
Huang is reportedly due to appear before the House Foreign Affairs, Intelligence and China Select Committees on December 1. "The American people need answers on Mr. Huang and Nvidia’s role in allowing dangerous PRC actors to access our most advanced chips, as well as the role of a potential Chinese intelligence asset in this scandal,” Reps. Brian Mast, R-Fla., John Moolenaar, R-Mich., and Rick Crawford, R-Ark., the chairs of the Foreign Affairs, China Select and Intelligence Committees, said in a statement reported by CNBC .
Photo by Nadja Wohlleben/Getty Images.

pool.titulo: Blade Runner 2099 Review
pool.resumen: Review: Blade Runner 2099 is a disappointing continuation of the iconic series with miscast leads and a propensity to fan service.
pool.contenido:
All eight episodes of Blade Runner 2099 debut on Prime Video on November 25. This is a spoiler-free review.
There’s a scene in 2017’s Blade Runner 2049 where the very grim and serious Agent K (Ryan Gosling) makes a joke about a Wallace Corp. employee’s lost baby pictures. “Well, it’s a shame… you must’ve been adorable,” K says straight-faced. It’s a moment of levity in a pretty heavy movie, with Gosling playing it without even cracking a smile, and it works wonderfully to keep us afloat amid all the darkness – as do several other such instances in the film.
The people behind Blade Runner 2099, the latest installment in the series which began with the 1982 Ridley Scott/Harrison Ford movie , don’t understand this, or at the very least don’t think they need to include such moments of humor or lightness in their new show. As a result, watching Blade Runner 2099 very quickly turns into a slog, leading to an increasing feeling with each passing episode that the show is crushing inward on you like the teeming, downtrodden masses of its futuristic Los Angeles.
It’s not just the oh-so-serious scripting that leads to this unforced error, however. 2099 also suffers from the performances of leads Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer, who seem to be trying to out-gloom each other for most of these eight episodes. The result is a buddy-cop story where the cops not only aren’t buddies, but are also unappealing and ultimately a drag to be around. Where’s Harrison Ford and his noodles when you need them!?
Set 50 years after 2049 (obviously), and 80 years after Ford’s Deckard was Blading and Running, the new series picks up the threads of the Replicant revolution that was just about to get underway in that previous film. In the intervening decades, the Replicants – humanoid robots formerly used as slave labor, for those who have never actually seen a Blade Runner movie (and judging by box office figures, there are a lot of you) – won that war. So now, that which man made rules over man. And they’re not terribly nice about it, either!
It's a buddy-cop story where the cops not only aren’t buddies, but are also unappealing and ultimately a drag to be around. Where’s Harrison Ford and his noodles when you need them!? Yeoh – who after the Star Trek disaster that was Section 31 two years ago and now this misfire may want to reconsider the whole small screen sci-fi thing – stars as Olwen, a Replicant Blade Runner whose built-in termination date is nearing. She’s seen things you people wouldn’t believe, don’t you know, having lived Off-World in the past – something the franchise has only spoken about in previous iterations but never shown until now – but now she’s ready to head off to the great unknown like all Replicants must do…
Enter Schafer as Cora, a human who through a confluence of events winds up having to pretend to be a Replicant, and not just a Replicant, but a Replicant Blade Runner working among other Replicant Blade Runners. And those Replicant Blade Runners are smart! And wily! And dangerous! And as I said earlier, not terribly nice. It’s a tricky situation for Cora, and the constant look of paralyzed terror on her face is completely credible and understandable, given her situation. The only problem is that look becomes Schafer’s main mode for 2099, and when combined with Olwen’s icy shoot-first, put-a-weird-bag-over-your-head-that-shoves-a-tube-down-your-throat-later philosophy, the viewer may very quickly find themselves wondering who they’re rooting for here, or why.
Indeed, as the story progresses, involving the hunt for some mysterious information from deep in the Blade Runner past, there are a few supporting characters who are given a short time in the spotlight and actually prove that 2099 has inhabitants that are, you know, interesting. For example, this far into the future the Voight-Kampff machine – the device used to probe Replicants for empathy, or a lack thereof – has been replaced by human children who are seemingly sold by their parents into a life of indentured servitude and trained to be living empathy detectors. Katelyn Rose Downey plays one such child, a scary, inscrutable creature when we first meet her… until we get a bit of an origin story for her in a later episode. Then there’s Matthew Needham (Larys on House of the Dragon), who plays another Replicant who is smart, scary, and entirely dismissive of humanity. “Your whole world has already gone past you,” he says of mankind. Amy Lennox also appears as a Replicant, sort of cut from the Pris mode from the original film in that she’s child-like yet deadly. But most importantly, whenever she’s onscreen, it’s a reprieve from the constipated angst of our two leads.
And look, as a lifetime Blade Runner devotee – I saw the original film when it was first released in a drive-in with my parents! – I take no pleasure in dismissing 2099. I’m also fully aware that the whole thing about Blade Runner is being dark and dreary, with Ford’s Deckard complaining about his ex-wife (depending on which cut you watched) and Gosling’s K on a doomed mission of self-salvation and so on. Those guys weren’t exactly a barrel of laughs, but they did have a charisma that let their characters be part of the Blade Runner dystopia without being engulfed by it. That’s not the case here.
Which isn’t to say that 2099 doesn’t have its merits. Certainly the production is a wonder to behold – how they make these shows that look like big-budget movies these days and don’t break the bank is beyond me. This is the Los Angeles (and elsewhere) of Blade Runner, without a doubt, and every flying spinner car and Tyrell Corporation tower is perfectly realized. The costuming is, well, interesting at times, seemingly competing for the biggest shoulder pads in the history of shoulder pads, but hey, it’s the future!

pool.titulo: Why You Probably Shouldn't Steal a Tesla in GTA 6
pool.resumen: Since GTA 5, Rockstar has parodied the Tesla brand with the fictional Coil line of cars. Well, with GTA 6, Rockstar has taken the Tesla parody to another level.
pool.contenido:
Since GTA 5 , Rockstar has parodied the Tesla brand with the fictional Coil line of cars. Well, with GTA 6 , Rockstar has taken the Tesla parody to another level.
Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 follow.
GTA 6 players have discovered that the game's version of Tesla cars are equipped with advanced security measures that prevent you from stealing the vehicle — and their owners get preferential treatment from the police.
Whenever you try to steal a Coil car, a mechanism kicks in and locks you inside. Then, the car will either drive itself to the nearest police station, or force you to stay put until the cops arrive and arrest you.
Do NOT steal is Tesla in GTA 6 😭 https://t.co/cYcsu7EWim
— Lucky Chamu (@LuckyChamu) November 22, 2026
GTA 6. 玩家不能偷老马的特斯拉
偷玩直接被自动驾驶送到警察局
太好玩了
#GTA6 #特斯拉 https://t.co/QvrQuvA2H7
— ycchong (@ycchong188) November 22, 2026
Now, there is a way to escape, but you'll still be without the vehicle. It seems that the only way to make it out of there is to bust the window and climb out before the cops arrive. Otherwise, you can try and make a run for it when the cops drag you out of the car, but by that point you're probably surrounded and very much in tasering range.
I hopped in-game to try this out, and found that none of the other Tesla-like electric vehicles produced the same results, so it's likely just the Coils that have this mechanic. You can't steal any of these electric cars until you get a key cloner anyway, but you can hop into one that's already unlocked (by 'borrowing' it from its owner when it's still running) and drive away to safety. They're worth a lot of money and are significantly cheaper to charge up as opposed to filling a car up with gas, so it's a good get if you can nab one.
As for the Coils, you might have more luck if you find one where the security has been deactivated, but it's unclear if that's possible — if it is, we're all still looking for one.

I have a pair myself and I use them every day. They’re one of my favorite pieces of technology that I own. This is a fantastic Apple Black Friday deal – one that’s so good it may sell out or disappear before long.
AirPods Pro 3 for $149
Every year since they’ve been available, AirPods Pro have been some of the most popular items among IGN readers. They’re super high quality, with excellent noise cancellation when you want it, and excellent pass-through when you don’t. I walk and run and do chores around the house in these things. I listen to podcasts and audiobooks and music, and it all sounds terrific.
And while they work as general earbuds with any Bluetooth device, they work exceptionally well when paired with Apple devices . They link up instantly with whatever device you’re using, and they switch between them without missing a beat. So you can listen to a podcast on your iPhone. Then pause it and pick up your iPad to watch a video, and you’ll hear the sound from the video, no problem. You can put down your iPad, and press play on some music on your Mac, and it switches to the Mac without any problem.
More Apple Black Friday Deals
The noise cancellation is probably my favorite feature of AirPods Pro 3. It’s fantastic. You can mow the lawn, vacuum, or use a leaf blower and still hear your content with crystal clarity. When you’re listening to compatible media, you’ll get Apple’s Spatial Audio, which makes it sound like it’s coming from a particular direction in the room around you. It’s a really cool effect.
At any rate, $149 is the lowest price AirPods Pro 3 have ever been. I don’t think I’ve seen a price this low on any previous model, either, even during previous Black Fridays. The lowest I can remember seeing them is $159. So grab this deal if you could use a quality pair of noise-cancelling earbuds, especially if you’re in the Apple hardware ecosystem. pool.titulo: GTA 6 Motion Capture Actor Has No Idea Who He Is in the Game, Sparks Social Media Hunt to Find His Character
pool.resumen: One GTA 6 actor has no idea who he plays and has asked for fans to help him find his character in the game.
pool.contenido:
One GTA 6 actor has no idea who he plays and has asked for fans to help him find his character in the game. Guy A. Fortt, who has previously played a guard in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos, did some performance capture work on GTA 6, but the secrecy of the project meant he didn’t have much context for his scenes.
Actors are often kept in the dark when playing a part in Rockstar games. When Roger Clark auditioned for Red Dead Redemption 2 , for example, the only clue he had at the time was he was told to wear cowboy boots. That secrecy, combined with the time between performance and the game’s release, hasn’t helped in Fortt’s case.
“So, I was a motion capture actor on GTA 6, but I don’t know who the hell I am,” Fortt explained in a video that went viral on Instagram . “I auditioned about four or five years ago, they put the balls all over my body and face … and then I forgot all about it.”
“Then I get a random email telling me that I’m in GTA 6. This is where I need your help.”
Fortt, who is 63 years old and doesn't have a PS5 or play video games himself, is looking for help tracking the character down. According to the actor, his performance saw him standing behind a counter of some kind, and he interacted with Jason and Lucia at one point.
He could be some kind of store clerk, a receptionist, or even a cop at a desk, judging by his description. It would be very funny if he ended up being a guard again, like in Jessica Jones and The Sopranos.
The community is currently on the hunt for his character, but it might take a while. Rockstar put lots of work into making GTA 6 NPCs varied , hiring dozens and dozens of actors to breathe life into the citizens of Leonida. In a follow-up social media post on day two of the hunt, Fortt said 3 million people were looking for his character in the game, but no luck yet. I assume that's based on social media impressions to his various posts on this, rather than people actively looking for his character in the game. But still, he's caught quite a bit of attention for this.

pool.titulo: Un cuaderno de Death Note acaba con una investigación policial en un colegio. Una alumna tenía su nombre entre las páginas
pool.resumen:

pool.titulo: Cyberpunk 2 creative director says he's suffering from 'GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression,' jokes that 'Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled'
pool.resumen: Tough act to follow.
pool.contenido:
It's been a big week for videogames—or rather, videogame. Grand Theft Auto 6 is enjoying what may very well be the single greatest media launch in history, securing over $3.7 billion in launch sales. But as Rockstar enjoys its acclaim, other developers—like Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski—are professing some anxiety about releasing their own games in a post-GTA 6 world.
"GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression is real. Probably the single greatest artistic achievement in history, I mean it. Scale, density, coherence, thoughtfulness of it all, just a technological and creative miracle," Sarzynski said on Bluesky over the weekend, joking that "Cyberpunk 2 is cancelled."
That news came as a surprise to Cyberpunk 2 lead writer Anna Megill, who replied with a baffled "But wait—"
Sarzynski was, of course, just goofing. But I'm sympathetic to any game dev who might be feeling an amount of apprehension about being measured against GTA 6's success, particularly when there's a genre overlap.
In Cyberpunk 2's case, however, CD Projekt is very much in its own lane: Cyberpunk is a different thematic setting, with entirely different systems and design goals. I'd hope that any reasonable person would think comparing the two is like comparing apples and oranges—particularly when the oranges reportedly had a production budget upwards of $1 billion .
In a follow-up post , Sarzynski acknowledged that each project is doing its own thing, while noting that GTA 6's example will benefit other game developers by serving as a source of creative inspiration.
"Seriously though, I think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor," he said. "GTA is impressive in a way all great art is: It expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed."

pool.titulo: GTA 6 players swore the weather system was broken and the latest patch has confirmed those suspicions

In my first 30 hours of Grand Theft Auto 6 , I think I saw it rain once. And that was during a particularly gloomy main story mission where it felt like it was intentionally flipped on and not a serendipitous moment created by the game's weather system.
I was not alone in wondering what was up with the weather in Leonida. GTA 6 players have been confused by the lack of rain and fog since day one, especially after Rockstar boasted about the kind of storms and hurricanes it can create to Game Informer in September.
Apparently, the questioning was justified: The weather system was broken and should now be fixed in a new patch that went out today.
"Fixed an issue that resulted in weather not changing for extended periods," the patch notes say, confirming that, while some players witnessed changes in weather, it was not properly happening at the rate it was intended.
You don't partner with The Weather Channel to post exclusive pre-release screenshots of your game if the forecast is mostly sunny and not actually representative of Florida, the state with the most unpredictable weather in the US. GTA 6 has realistically detailed radio towers that left a TikTok guy who's worked on them in real life gobsmacked. It would've been bizarre if Rockstar neglected to put that kind of effort into a system normies like me would notice within a few hours.
The sun's reign is over and all the other meteorological conditions can take the spotlight. As someone who takes their time doing all the silly little daily routines in Jason and Lucia's life and abiding by traffic laws for the vibes, I'm excited to see how much the weather affects the mood. I'll just have to remember to be a little more discerning when chasing down one of GTA 6's cars to make sure I don't absolutely ruin the interior from a surprise storm.

pool.titulo: Former Dragon Age boss questions whether BioWare should have become 'a one project studio' dropping either Mass Effect or Dragon Age to survive EA
pool.resumen: "There are lots of studios within EA that did that and it didn't work—they still got murdered in their sleep."
pool.contenido:
Many are asking themselves how a legendary studio like BioWare, which is responsible for staples of the PC gaming genre like Neverwinter Nights , Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , and the OG Baldur's Gate , alongside Mass Effect and Dragon Age , can be shuttered.
Former Dragon Age executive producer Mark Darrah has already explained how the studio was backed into a corner by EA. Escalating financial pressure led to the poor decisions and subpar games we saw ahead of BioWare's closure. But what if it had all gone differently? Despite everything, Darrah does question whether there was a way for BioWare to survive under EA.
"BioWare's entire existence under EA—it was essentially zero sum, if somebody was getting resources it was coming at the expense of somebody else," Darrah explains. "It's almost like BioWare has run exactly the same way for its entire existence. But the external constraints were different. So in the early days when BioWare needed more people it hired more people. That's like Baldur's Gate 1, Neverwinter Nights, in the early days when we have all these different threads and branches.
"And then in 2007/2008, when the EA constraints come in, the same desires are there, we need more people to ship our games so the way we fix that in that time period is by cutting off all those other branches. So [Jade Empire sequel] Revolver goes away and the Handheld [Development] Group goes away … and so Dragon Age and Mass Effect eats everything."
The alternative? Scaling things down to meet EA's needs. "Budgets keep going up, but we're still not getting bigger… So what's happening is that the walls are closing in and we're trying to be three things [SWTOR, Mass Effect, Dragon Age] and arguably we can only afford to be two things, or one thing." There's no telling whether this would've saved BioWare, but it has worked for other studios.
"Maxis figured out how to live inside of EA and BioWare never did," Darrah adds. Focusing on just one project does seem to be the answer, or at least Darrah believes it has been for Maxis and Battlefield Studios, which both had games that initially underperformed and weren't well received. "If [Battlefield Studios] don't work on Battlefield then you might as well shut the studio down. So they all work on Battlefield 4 and they fix Battlefield 4 and it becomes successful, like very successful after the fact. The Sims 4, same thing."
On the other hand "Mass Effect Andromeda ships and then Dragon Age 4 which has been starving for resources is like 'No, no [the devs] are supposed to come to us. Where are they?' That need to keep them in place isn't there in the same way. So when I say BioWare didn't adapt to EA, that's what I mean."

pool.titulo: Cyberleek releases executable for GTA 6 Xbox build leaked last week: 'The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects'
pool.resumen: The notorious GTA 6 leaker called it "an early Christmas gift."
pool.contenido:
Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek appears to have followed through on their threat to release the executable of the Xbox build of GTA 6 they put into the wild last week, calling it "an early Christmas gift" for followers and explicitly linking the leak to efforts to recreate the game on PC: "The torch passes to the open source recomp and emulation projects."
Cyberleek released a near-complete build of GTA 6 late last week, holding back only the main exe—the part that makes everything else run, basically—until either their crypto coin achieved a $15 million market cap, or November 23, whichever came first. The crypto missed badly, but time marches on, and so here we are.
The release of the exe, naturally, includes a call for more "donations" in its readme file (via Reddit ) which Cyberleek said will go toward a secretive project "for the gamers." They also taunted Take-Two Interactive's efforts to track them down : "Months of takedowns, subpoenas and wallet tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving. No budget makes a lock unbreakable, and no court order deletes what the internet already has."
Leaks in the game industry aren't anything new, but this case is unique: GTA 6, effectively the biggest videogame of all time, still hasn't been announced for PC, as is Take-Two's way . But the advent of AI means the game could be emulated on our platform far more quickly than was possible in the past—some modders estimated it could happen within a week.
One of the leads on the Leonida recomp project predicted that things will start to move quickly from here:
At the same time, Shayder tempered expectations in a message on the Leonida Discord, saying "it will take at least a week" for the project to reach the point where GTA will be playable on PC.
How that unofficial emulated made-with-AI build would compare to the real deal is an open question, and I strongly suspect the answer will be "not well," but even just having something GTA 6-ish playable on PC is a headache that I'm pretty sure Take-Two would rather not have to deal with. I also wonder whether it will prompt Take-Two to release GTA 6 on PC more quickly than it has with previous releases. A rumor to that effect surfaced in October and I had serious doubts, but it's possible that ongoing emulation efforts will expedite its arrival..
I haven't verified whether the released exe is legit, but the previously-released material appears to be and the general consensus is that this is too. And with that, I will remind you (yes, again) that software piracy is illegal, and shady files from strangers on the internet can contain malware.

pool.titulo: D'Angelo's Estate Speaks Out After Late Artist's Unreleased Song, Kamikaze, Discovered in GTA 6
pool.resumen: The estate of late American R&B artist D’Angelo has spoken out after the launch of GTA 6, which featured a song that he created for the game back in 2024.
pool.contenido:
The estate of late American R&B artist D’Angelo has spoken out after the launch of GTA 6, which featured a song that he created for the game back in 2024.
GTA 6 features a slew of songs, both licensed and original, from a wide variety of high-profile music artists. Names like Cardi B, Tame Impala, Burna Boy, and many more contributed to the game’s soundtrack . D’Angelo was one of those artists who created a track for the game two years ahead of its highly anticipated November 2026 launch.
The song, titled ‘Kamikaze,’ is a funky tune that players quickly discovered during their playthroughs. Snippets of the track were uploaded to social media mere days after GTA 6’s release, and now, D’Angelo’s estate has officially confirmed the track’s existence in the game.
The track and its title were shared on November 23, 2026, in a series of Instagram posts on D’Angelo’s official profile. One of these included a statement penned by his brother, Luther Archer, who described how
“Michael approved this track in its current form in November of 2024 to be released as part of Grand Theft Auto VI. He was a tremendous admirer of Rockstar Games and a past collaborator of theirs, and he was enthusiastic (to say the least) to have this record included in the game and released to a wide audience as a single,” Archer wrote.
“Kamikazi was produced by D'Angelo himself, with Slingbaum and engineer/trusted ally Ben Kane. It features performances from D'Angelo and Slingbaum alongside Yussef Dayes (drums on the left) and the late legendary James Gadson (drums on the right). The cover artwork was done by Andre Trenier, the genius brother of Michael's mentor and longtime manager Dominque Trenier.”
D’Angelo has a storied history with Rockstar; he created a song for the Red Dead Redemption 2 soundtrack titled ‘May I? Stand Unshaken,’ a collaboration that came about after he asked to playtest the game at Rockstar’s New York Offices before its release.
“D’Angelo’s actually a massive, massive, massive fan of the game — more than I ever knew,” Rockstar Games’ Director of Music and Audio, Ivan Pavlovich, told Rolling Stone in a 2018 interview.
“He would come in here [Rockstar’s New York city office] and just play the game. We weren’t even talking about doing music. When D’Angelo comes through, he shows up at midnight, and he’s playing the game until four in the morning. Each time he was just like, ‘It’s incredible.’ It just blows his mind. He’s such a fan. I have never seen someone that excited.”
D’Angelo died of pancreatic cancer at the age of 51 in October 2025. Since then, his brother, Luther Archer, has taken over the task of releasing his posthumous works — one of which is featured in the biggest media release of all time from a company that was near and dear to D’Angelo’s heart.

pool.titulo: Players Have Found a GTA 6 60fps Glitch, but It Just Reaffirms Rockstar's 30fps Cap
pool.resumen: One of GTA 6's biggest controversies was Rockstar's decision to keep the game's framerate locked at 30 fps, rather than allowing for an unlocked mode. Over the weekend, players managed to find a glitch on Xbox Series X that lets you unlock the frame rate, albeit to mixed results.
pool.contenido:
One of GTA 6 's biggest controversies was Rockstar's decision to keep the game's framerate locked at 30fps , rather than allowing for an unlocked mode. Over the weekend, players managed to find a glitch on Xbox Series X that lets you unlock the frame rate, albeit to mixed results.
The glitch is performed by booting up the game when the Xbox console is set to 60fps, then going into the console settings, switching the system to 120fps, launching another game, and then using Quick Resume to start GTA 6 back up. That process essentially tricks the system into unlocking the frame rate, and some people have been able to push it a bit higher than the game's default 30fps lock.
The folks over at Digital Foundry were able to put the '60fps glitch' to the test, though, and found that while you could push upwards of 60fps, it was limited to situations where, "If you look straight up in the ocean, frame-rates can just about graze 60fps."
Instead, Digital Foundry's results reaffirm Rockstar's decision to ship the game with a 30fps lock. While the game managed an average of 36fps in the first hour of the game, GTA 6 only gets more demanding as it progresses into Vice City, where NPCs and explosions are both more prevalent. And, in those situations, the game still has sharp drops to lower frame rates.
The whole reason a 30fps cap makes sense for GTA 6 is consistency. While this glitch shows that the game sometimes has the headroom to peek above 30fps, and even into the 40s, getting rid of the cap would just mean the difference between the peaks and valleys of the frame rate would be even higher, and thus more noticeable. It's no secret that the game does drop below 30 fps during heavy action or when you're speeding through the world, but any dip from 40fps to 24fps would be a lot more jarring than a dip from 30fps to 24fps.
This glitch has given some fans renewed hope that an unlocked version of the game would come out at some point, but Rockstar has been pretty clear about this generation's technical limitations. Right as GTA 6 was coming out, Rockstar technology production director Marc Chambers flat-out said that the PS5 Pro processor "is not powerful enough to run the game's complex simulation at higher frame rates." That's something I've noticed myself as I've started to cause more problems in Vice City.
Still, it would be nice to play GTA 6 at a higher frame rate, even if I have to wait for the PC version to do so. Luckily, it does seem like a PC port will be coming faster than previous entries , due to Rockstar's worry about an unofficial and AI-assisted port of the game. It's even starting to look like its fears on that front were justified .

pool.titulo: Are Couples Really Breaking Up Over GTA 6?
pool.resumen: Grand Theft Auto 6 has everything you could possibly want from a video game: crime, chaos, expensive cars, and, apparently, the ability to end your real-life relationship.
pool.contenido:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has everything you could possibly want from a video game: crime, chaos, expensive cars, and, apparently, the ability to end your real-life relationship .
Social media is filling up with people claiming GTA 6 has caused them to break up with their significant others. Some are apparently fed up with their partners spending more time in Vice City than with them, while others seem to have discovered that a fictional romance between two career criminals is somehow setting unrealistic expectations for their own love lives. And while I'm sure there are genuine arguments happening in households across the world right now, I'm going to need a little more convincing that people are actually ending their relationships over Rockstar's latest game.
My homie going thru it with his girl over GTA 6 she threatening to break up with bro🤦🏻‍♂️🤣
— Cartier (@swagcartierr) November 18, 2026
my roommate and her bf are genuinely about to break up over gta 6 LMFAOOOO
— viv 🐈‍⬛ (@unredloveletter) November 19, 2026
It's true that GTA 6 is the biggest entertainment launch of all time . It's the sort of game that people have been planning their lives around for years, booking time off work, clearing their schedules, and presumably warning loved ones that they might not be emotionally available for the foreseeable future. That's hardly conducive to a healthy relationship, particularly if one half of the couple has absolutely no interest in video games. But there's a difference between being annoyed that your boyfriend has spent 14 consecutive hours driving around Leonida and packing your bags because he won't stop playing.
GTA 6 is actually about to end my relationship https://t.co/UsOJlQQvIt
— Sebastian Sekulovski (@Sebbers) November 16, 2026
There's also the Jason and Lucia factor. GTA 6's central couple have become something of a social media phenomenon, particularly thanks to the optional romantic gestures that allow Jason to be an attentive boyfriend. He can buy flowers, open car doors, and generally behave like someone who understands that being in a relationship involves occasionally doing something nice for the other person.
Comment
by
u/LSwarby10 from discussion
in
GTA6unmoderated
On the other side, some people are claiming that they truly consider investing time in the couple's relationship as cheating , a response that seems to come purely from people seeing that Lucia is attractive, or thanks to misconceptions about sex workers, strip clubs, or the in-game intimacy options. In fact, 19% of polled respondents said they would "not be okay" with their partner spending time on fictional relationships in a video game, as per a YouGov poll published October 2026.
After 3 years of relationship we broke up cuz of GTA 6
by
u/OutlandishnessReal85 in
GTA
Of course, social media has never been particularly concerned with letting the truth get in the way of a good post. Announcing that you've dumped your boyfriend because he loves GTA 6 more than you do is practically engineered to generate engagement. It gets the gamers angry, the relationship commentators become involved, and everyone else arguing in the replies. One that's gone particulary viral is a woman in her bathroom claiming that she's getting divorced specifically because her husband won't stop playing. It's worth noting that her other posts on the topic say 'satire 'in the discussions, and this one says, "For entertainment purposes only!!!"
Another Instagram post about a supposed break up has the same influencer telling a story about being accused of cheating because she was playing GTA 6 online with someone else's boyfriend. GTA 6 does not currently have an online or co-op mode, so it's worth taking these types of posts with a healthy grain of salt.
That's not to say gaming can't cause genuine friction between couples; if your partner is consistently ignoring you, neglecting responsibilities, or treating your relationship like an irritating side quest, that's a problem. But it's probably an issue that existed well before GTA 6 arrived. Are people genuinely breaking up over GTA 6? Possibly. Are some people exaggerating for attention? Almost certainly. Until there's more than a handful of viral posts to go on, I'm inclined to remain skeptical. Besides, if your relationship can be destroyed by a video game, I suspect Rockstar wasn't the real villain here.

pool.titulo: Yaga Gets Renewed for Season 2 at Crave, Carrie-Anne Moss to Return

pool.contenido:
Canadian streaming service Crave has greenlit the mystery thriller series Yaga for a second season with Carrie-Anne Moss confirmed to return. The decision comes prior to Season 1's two-episode finale on November 27.
Yaga debuted on October 23 and quickly became #1 on Crave. It also took the top spot for its biggest "exclusive series launch ever" on AMC+ in the U.S., along with holding the #1 position in multiple other countries around the world.
“The incredible response to Yaga has blown us away,” Justin Stockman, vice president of global content for Bell Media said in a press release. “Congratulations to Kat Sandler and our production partners at Blink49 Studios and Front Street Pictures. Together, we’ve created a bold and daring Canadian series that we believe strongly in, and we can’t wait to see where Season 2 takes us.”
Pancho Mansfield, president of global scripted at Blink49 Studios, added, “Kat Sandler has brought such a bold and distinctive vision to Yaga, and we’re incredibly proud to have supported her in bringing it to the screen. To see her first television series as creator and showrunner resonate with audiences in Canada and around the world has been enormously rewarding. We’re thrilled to continue our partnership with Bell Media to bring the next chapter of Yaga to life.”
For those unfamiliar, Yaga is a modern retelling of the European folklore around Baba Yaga – a witch who takes on the role of both villain and mentor, harnessing both good and evil depending on the story. The new series is from Kat Sandler, who created a stage play of the same name and serves as writer, showrunner, and executive producer.

pool.titulo: Naruto Movie Closes in on Casting Hiroyuki Sanada as Live-Action Hiruzen Sarutobi
pool.resumen: Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie.
pool.contenido:
Hiroyuki Sanada has reportedly entered final negotiations to play Hiruzen Sarutobi in Destin Daniel Cretton's live-action Naruto movie .
The Mortal Kombat and Shogun actor's potential role in the anime-to-film adaptation was first reported by Deadline . Should talks with Cretton and Lionsgate check those last few boxes, he will appear as the Hidden Leaf Village's Hokage leader.
How Sanada may help the iconic Hokage lead to the big screen remains to be seen. Meanwhile, the site's report stated that Charles Melton (Warfare, Beef Season 2), who was said to be in final negotiations to play Kakashi back in August, is still in talks to join Naruto.
The Spider-Man: Brand New Day director's shot at bringing one of the most beloved manga and anime properties of all time into the live-action realm is expected to begin filming sometime in spring 2027 . With production right around the corner, though, Sony and Lionsgate have shared little about which actors have been picked to play some of the franchise's most important roles.
The only names we've heard so far are Melton and Sanada, and even their parts in the story haven't been outright confirmed just yet. Depending on what story Cretton and company hope to tell, there is still plenty of room for additional casting updates. Names like Sasuke, Sakura, and, of course, Naruto still have no names publicly attached, though that doesn't necessarily mean that stars haven't been picked behind the scenes.
Lionsgate confirmed it had initiated a global casting search for actors to play the leads in the live-action Naruto picture. Specifically, it said it was on the lookout for stars for Team 7, suggesting the actors picked to appear as Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura could be unknown names in the movie space.
"[Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto-sensei's] stories have inspired generations of fans around the world, and it’s an honor to bring his world and characters to the big screen in live action for the very first time," Cretton said at the time of the global casting search reveal. "I'm thrilled to kick off this worldwide casting search for our Team 7 and to bring the incredible universe of Naruto to life!"
The live-action Naruto movie currently has no release date. For more, you can check out Kishimoto's new manga tease . You can also catch up on how to watch all of Naruto in order .

Nice-guy Fortnite streamer Nick Eh 30 has gone viral after trying GTA 6 — and immediately pushing the violence in Rockstar's game to its limit.
For almost a decade, cheery Canadian streamer Nicholas " Nick Eh 30 " Amyoony has amassed a community of millions around his family-friendly Fortnite streams. His personal brand is based on pushing positivity, he's known for never swearing on camera, and he's become one of the few Twitch stars partnered with Epic Games to get a skin of himself made available in-game.
So it has, understandably, come as something of a surprise to see wholesome Nick Eh 30 embracing the most dastardly deeds GTA 6 has on offer: kicking pet dogs to death in the street , shooting animals in the zoo , and walking down the length of a train executing every passenger at point blank range .
As someone who has followed Nick Eh 30 for a while, seeing him wandering around GTA 6's world eliminating swathes of its animal population while chuckling to himself is indeed odd to see. Social media is awash with similar reactions, with posts from his followers stating things like: "IN WHAT UNIVERSE DO YOU NEED TO BE DOING THIS" and "Years of building ramps in Fortnite could not prepare chat for this."
But this is all clearly intentional, down to his streams being labelled as humorously promising "family friendly GTA" gameplay (I'm not sure there's any such thing). And the fact this has led people to actually discuss his streams and share clips further has only proven why he's likely doing this.

pool.titulo: Steven Spielberg Teams Up With Cillian Murphy for New Western Written by Paul Thomas Anderson
pool.resumen: Steven Spielberg is going big with his next film, which is a Western written by Paul Thomas Anderson and starring Cillian Murphy.
pool.contenido:
Steven Spielberg is going big with his next film, which is a Western written by Paul Thomas Anderson and starring Cillian Murphy.
Deadline confirmed that Spielberg is already developing his next film following the release of Disclosure Day this summer, and it'll be an adaptation of the 2024 novel The Heart in Winter. The book is set in 1891 amid a harsh winter in a Montana mining town. It follows a degenerate poet and ballad-maker who crosses paths with the new bride of the town's mine captain, sparking an intense love affair before they run west together with pursuers hot on their tail. Spielberg described the project to Deadline as a story about "people who refused to settle for a life that is less than they deserve but maybe more than they can handle."
Cillian Murphy and Jessie Buckley will play the leading characters in the film, which is apparently still untitled despite being sourced from an existing piece of work. He has also teamed with Oscar-winner Paul Thomas Anderson, who is penning the script. This marks the first time Anderson has fully written a script that he himself hasn't directed, but he has done uncredited punch-ups and rewrites on other movies like Killers of the Flower Moon.
“It’s really the excitement for me to get to work together with my dear friend and colleague Paul Thomas Anderson on a genre, but more particularly, the genre notwithstanding, a story that quite quickly became close to both our hearts and we felt that we could do as a team," said Spielberg about the partnership.
The two began flirting with the idea of working together back in January while Anderson was on the awards trail for One Battle After Another, which cleaned up at the various ceremonies and led to him receiving an Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay . Naturally, that kind of prestige makes him a smart pick to adapt a layered novel such as this one. The two binged old Westerns on 35mm film as part of their creative process.
Spielberg's untitled Western is currently targeting a 2028 release, with filming set to begin next winter. The 79-year-old director was also quick to note that this is not his final project and denied that this was some kind of metaphor about his career, where he gets to literally ride off into the sunset at the end.
“If I wanted to ride off into the sunset, I would have done Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade next, and I could have had those characters literally riding off into the sunset as the credits roll,” Spielberg said.

pool.titulo: The Internet Reacts to Jensen Huang's Shock Return as Nvidia CEO
pool.resumen: The internet is reacting to Jensen Huang's shock return as Nvidia CEO.
pool.contenido:
Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following two weeks of scandals involving alleged affairs, with one involving a suspected spy.
Just last week, Nvidia CFO Collette Kress, who served as interim CEO during Huang's absence, had ruled out that he would return, and the company also took the opportunity to implement a new oversight committee to prevent more security scandals in the future.
While Nvidia was picking up the pieces, Huang went on his own journey to return to Nvidia , putting out a statement suggesting he would be willing to return as CEO if the board thought it would be best for the company. And, well, it seems like that's exactly what happened. In a press release issued earlier this morning, Nvidia Board Chair Harvey C. Jones said: "The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers."
It does seem like the U.S. Government played a big role in Huang's return. Nvidia's own statement says, "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk." President Donald Trump has also been posting through it, most recently saying that, "I hope the Board of Nvidia rehires Jensen Huang. It would be the best thing for the Company, and also, for the U.S.A."
But in the hours since Huang's return, it's become clear just how much Trump tipped the scales in his favor. Trump spoke with Nvidia's board and brokered a deal to ensure his return, according to an interview with CNBC . Beyond saying that he "convinced them" and "made the deal," Trump gave Nvidia assurances over the national security implications. According to Trump: "And we gave them assurances at least with everything we know, and we know a lot."
Trump then called Huang personally, telling CNBC: "He knows what to do and what not to do. But I just said work hard because if you work hard, there’s nobody that can capture what you’ve done. Nobody, nobody close."
According to CBS senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang , "Trump says if Huang had not been reinstated at Nvidia, Xi might have called and asked him to lead a Chinese company. If Huang was 'mad' enough at the U.S. Trump said he may have done it… adding he has some of their 'blood in him.'"
Trump wasn't acting alone. According to Semafor White House correspondent Shelby Talcott, Vice President JD Vance played a big role in Huang's return too. Talcott tweeted: "VP JD Vance was deeply involved in the process to bring Jensen Huang back to Nvidia. He and POTUS were 'personally engaged' over the weekend to resolve the situation, a source familiar tells me — Vance used his relationships in Silicon Valley + business community to help move the Nvidia board along."
Nvidia bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO was always going to be a controversial move, but the Trump administration's role in the shocking development has caused backlash online.
Over on the Nvidia subreddit , most of the comments are calling out alleged corruption, with the top comment quoting Nvidia's input from the government, with the first reply saying, "lmaooo It's f**king hilarious to watch how corrupt that country is now." Another comment in the same thread simply says: "The USA is truly the most corrupt country among democracies."
In our own comments, user Killarogue added: "Society is broken. This dude should be investigated, and if the reports are true, sent to prison for illegally selling chips to customers in China. Specifically the H200 chips to blacklisted customers within China." While another user, ZeroZep, said: "Pretty disgusting but I guess that’s par for course in the society we live in today. Now let’s see the spy and shady business practice allegations magically go away too."
Meanwhile, on social media, the White House tweeted out Trump's thoughts on Huang's return : "The Nvidia Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO… Congratulations to Jensen, the Nvidia Board, to the People of the United States — and, indeed, the World!" There was also a critical mass of AI-generated gifs of Huang returning to the office.
At the same time, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker tweeted: "This is the greed and lack of accountability that the country just rejected. There are serious national security concerns being raised about Jensen Huang that should not be papered over by this administration or the Nvidia board."
Utah Senator John Curtis also had questions, posting on Twitter: "Nvidia’s board says it relied on input from senior U.S. officials to conclude that bringing Jensen Huang back posed no national security risk. I have some questions. Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board? And on what basis did the board conclude there was no risk?"
MSNBC's Sam Stein added: "I think it's worth being candid about what happened here. The U.S. government pressured the board of a private company to reinstate a CEO who had compromised U.S. national security and broken serious internal HR policies because they liked what he did to the share price."
But amid corruption concerns, there were plenty of people joking about the timing of Huang's return. Rapper Lotus Juice tweeted: "Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO? It’s almost like he took time off just for GTA6 lol"
Gamer's Nexus also joked about Huang's return, referencing Morrowind's classic "with this character's death, the thred of prophecy is severed," along with a caption that simply says: "Quick load."
Only time will tell if this saga is actually over, and what the long-term ramifications are going to be. During the course of Huang's absense, new allegations arose about his management style , and at one point Elon Musk even floated the idea of hiring him .

pool.titulo: Brad Pitt Gives Promising Update on World War Z 2
pool.resumen: Brad Pitt has given a promising update on the status of World War Z 2, a film that has been in development hell for over a decade.
pool.contenido:
Brad Pitt has given a promising update on the status of World War Z 2 , a film that has been in development hell for over a decade.
In 2013, Paramount released World War Z starring Brad Pitt, which became the highest-grossing zombie flick of all time. The movie itself wasn't anything to write home about, outside of a couple of cool action scenes, but it was a solid crowd-pleaser. And yet, Hollywood has been trying to crack the code on a follow-up for years. For a while, David Fincher was set to direct a sequel with Pitt returning , but that eventually fell apart. After that, it seemed like the project was dead.
However, as part of Skydance's new initiative to revitalize certain IP, leadership wants to prioritize a new World War Z film . When speaking with Collider , Pitt gave a small yet promising update on the film, which he believes could start shooting as soon as next year if they manage to lock down a script. He noted that they're "talking zombie logic" and polishing the script currently, trying to figure out a fresh angle on the genre.
"The thing is, it's well-worn territory," said Pitt in reference to zombie genre being somewhat saturated. "How do we keep it fresh? How do we take it somewhere it hasn't gone before? We've got some good ideas that I'm pretty excited about. We're fleshing them out now."
Should the film come to fruition, it will be directed by Edward Berger, who has directed acclaimed films such as Conclave and 2022's All Quiet on the Western Front. Pitt will also begin working on Ocean's 14 , the fourth film in the heist film franchise, sometime next year, as well.
Despite being 62 years old, Pitt clearly isn't backing down from his leading man role, particularly when it comes to intense and demanding action films like World War Z 2. As of right now, we'll just have to wait and see what happens. Does anyone really want a sequel to this movie 13 years later? It doesn't really seem like there's a flurry of demand for it, but at least the people behind the film seem passionate about it.

pool.titulo: Sea of Remnants: Set Sail for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta on XBOX Series X
pool.resumen:
Captains, your next adventure is on the horizon! We’re bringing Sea of Remnants to XBOX Series X for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Test to XBOX Insiders, beginning December 3. Gather your crew, prepare your ship, and get an early taste of a world filled with strange sea creatures, unlikely companions, and mysteries waiting beyond the […]
The post Sea of Remnants: Set Sail for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta on XBOX Series X appeared first on XBOX Wire .
pool.contenido:
Captains, your next adventure is on the horizon! We’re bringing Sea of Remnants to XBOX Series X for the Dawnbreaker Closed Beta Test to XBOX Insiders, beginning December 3. Gather your crew, prepare your ship, and get an early taste of a world filled with strange sea creatures, unlikely companions, and mysteries waiting beyond the next island.
Developed by Joker Studio, Sea of Remnants is a free-to-play turn-based roguelike adventure that combines exploration, strategic turn-based battles, and a distinctive puppetfolk world. Here’s what awaits on your first voyage and how to join us.
Find Your Crew, Chart Your Course
You begin as a sailor with lost memories, setting out alongside the mysterious R.S to discover what lies beyond the horizon. As Captain, you’ll recruit puppetfolk companions, assemble a combat team of up to four, and prepare a ship ready to brave the open sea.
Every voyage is an opportunity to strengthen your crew. Gather equipment, Sea Shanties, and Enhancement Dice, experiment with combinations, and discover new ways to turn a difficult battle in your favor. Between expeditions, return to Orbtopia, the bustling pirate city at the heart of your adventure. Explore the world of Sea of Remnants .
Discover What’s New
The Dawnbreaker CBT opens up the White Sea and Bridge Sea, with new Journey and Roaming quests to discover throughout both regions. A broader crew roster gives you more room to experiment with combat strategies, whether you prefer focused attacks or clearing the field with area damage.
You’ll also have two ships to try: the Drift Bottle and the Fireworks Wanderer, each with a different naval combat style. When you’re ready for a tougher challenge, take your favorite team into Peril Theatre and put your tactics to work. See the Dawnbreaker announcement.
Captain quests span the prologue through Chapter 3. For the first time, the test also opens the Sea of Remnants area and its core mechanics, giving Captains who complete a weekly Voyage a chance to reunite with a Black Spot crew member. Progression improvements and Quick Outfit make it easier to prepare your team and try new builds. Read Dev Talk Vol. 2.
Take a Piece of Dawnbreaker into Launch
Your first voyage will leave you with something to remember it by. Captains who participate in the Dawnbreaker CBT will receive an exclusive commemorative reward that carries over to the global launch of Sea of Remnants .
While your beta progress will be reset after the test, this reward will be yours to enjoy when the full adventure begins. Come aboard early, help shape the game, and mark the beginning of your journey!
How to Join
There are two ways to get access:
Join when the test opens. A limited number of direct registration spots will be available on launch day, first come, first served, subject to server capacity.
Enter the additional access draw. Pre-register for the game or sign up for the CBT, and create a NetEase Passport account. Selected players will receive an email with access results and download instructions.
Start at the official Dawnbreaker recruitment page. Signing up for the draw does not guarantee access.
Use the same email address for your NetEase account and game pre-registration so that access can be granted correctly. Watch for platform-specific download instructions as pre-download rolls out. This test supports XBOX Series X; XBOX Series S support is planned for global launch. Details in Dev Talk Vol. 2.
How to Download on XBOX Series X
Once pre-download is available on December 1, follow these steps to get ready:
On your XBOX Series X console, sign in and launch the XBOX Insider Hub app (or install the XBOX Insider Hub from the Store first if necessary)
Navigate to Previews > Sea of Remnants
Select Join
Wait for the registration to complete and be directed to the Store to install Sea of Remnants
Places are limited and available through launch-day registration or the additional access draw.
Mark Your Calendar
Pre-download begins: December 1, 2026, at 4:00 AM PST / 7:00 AM EST.
CBT begins: December 3, 2026, at 4:00 PM PST / 7:00 PM EST.
CBT ends: December 18, 2026, at 4:00 AM PST / 7:00 AM EST.
The test is free to participate in and welcomes players worldwide. Test progress will be wiped when it ends. You can share progress across supported platforms during the beta by signing in with the same NetEase Passport account. Full schedule and recruitment FAQ.

pool.titulo: The Grand Theft Auto 6 hacker who was hospitalized in 2023 has been released on parole with a warning not to do it again
pool.resumen: Following his guilty plea, Arion Kurtaj was given a seven-year sentence but released "on license" with a warning and restrictions to his online activity..
pool.contenido:
A BBC report says Arion Kurtaj, the Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker who was given an indefinite sentence in hospital in 2023 because he kept hacking into things or expressing intent to, has been released with a stern warning not to do it again.
Kurtaj was sentenced to seven years in prison, according to the report, but was released on license—similar to parole in North America—the same day, with his hospital stay and time in prison while awaiting retrial credited as time served. He was given a five-year "Serious Crime Prevention Order" restricting his allowable online activity, including bans on using Telegram and Discord.
"Kurtaj knew what he was doing when he carried out these crimes and has finally admitted his involvement," Detective Inspector Mike O'Sullivan of the City of London Police said following Kurtaj's sentencing and release. "We hope this case serves as a lesson that these types of acts will not be tolerated.
"Although cyber crime is borderless, we will seek to utilise the co-operation of partner agencies and international law enforcement to ensure that offenders are brought to justice no matter where they offend from."
Kurtaj carried out hacks against multiple companies when he was 16 and 17 years old, including Microsoft , Samsung , Nvidia and UK telecom company BT&EE, and stole millions in cryptocurrency from individuals.
But it was his hack of Rockstar and leak of GTA 6 materials more than a year before it was formally revealed, that earned him notoriety, not least because of how it was carried out: While under police protection in a Travelodge hotel room , using an Amazon Fire Stick and a mobile phone.
A psychiatric assessment determined that Kurtaj had "acute autism," and that he "continued to express the intent to return to cybercrime as soon as possible" while he was in custody. That led to his hospital sentence , but earlier this year he was found fit to stand trial and subsequently pleaded guilty to all charges .
That struck me as odd—why plead guilty to crimes carried out at a time when your mental state was such that a court decided you required multiple years of institutionalization?—but this may be the answer: Kurtaj, now 21, is a free man. The judge on the case told Kurtaj he is "a very talented young man," but also warned him: "Don't let this happen again."

pool.titulo: Sony: GTA 6 set record for 'highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation' ever
pool.resumen: The industry is finding new milestones to measure GTA 6's success.
pool.contenido:
GTA 6 has been shattering records since before it came out, becoming the top-rated game in the history of Metacritic before it had the biggest entertainment launch (by dollars) in history. Sony is now joining in that victory lap by sharing GTA 6 milestones as they pertain to PlayStation.
"More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia's story in Grand Theft Auto 6 on PlayStation 5," Sony content communications manager Tim Turi wrote in a blog post today. That is a staggering number, especially considering GTA 6 also launched on Xbox and will (eventually) hit PC .
But that's not a sales record—Rockstar still has a ways to go to surpass GTA 5's 230 million lifetime sales . What is unprecedented, at least for PlayStation, is GTA 6's concurrents over launch weekend.
"GTA 6 set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation, surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles," Turi said.
That's the wild one to me, because that means more people were playing GTA 6 at the same time on the largest console platform than Call of Duty, GTA 5, or even Fortnite has ever achieved. Turi didn't share the concurrent figure itself, which is too bad—Steam remains the only platform that hands out exact player data. If the figure is theoretically higher than some of the biggest concurrent peaks we know about on Steam, then it could've been as high as 3-4 million players.
On average, those 39 million PS5 players logged 17.4 hours over four days. Let's just say my hour count represents the higher end of that average, and I'm still less than halfway through the main story.

pool.titulo: GTA 6 players found a '60 fps glitch', but it’s too unstable to stop me from wishing it was on PC already
pool.resumen: Spoiler: It doesn't actually run at 60 fps.
pool.contenido:
Clever Grand Theft Auto 6 players have found a glitch with the Xbox version of the game that allows players to forcibly remove Rockstar's 30 fps cap. But even though people claim the game jumps up to 60 fps, the actual performance is nowhere near as smooth, according to Digital Foundry's tests.
The glitch is surprisingly simple to perform: You just need to set the console's output to 60 Hz, load GTA 6, swap the output to 120 Hz, load a different game, and then use the Quick Resume feature to go back to GTA 6. For whatever reason, this forces the game to run above 30 fps, but not by much.
In Digital Foundry's testing, GTA 6 doesn't suddenly become a buttery smooth 60 fps dream. Instead, it has an average frame rate of about 36 fps and still drops below that number during particularly intense scenes, like in city areas or when multiple cars are exploding due to rocket launcher hijinks.
The most notable improvement is lower input lag when it manages to climb up to around 40 fps, but even that has an asterisk because the frame rate varies too much for the benefits to be consistent. Unless you plan on spending your time in Leonida roleplaying as a fisherman, you're going to have a bad time.
While Rockstar technology production director Marc Chambers said an official 60 fps mode for GTA 6 is too much for the current generation of consoles to handle, including the PS5 Pro, Digital Foundry theorizes that a 40 fps mode might be possible in the future.
I'm hopeful for console players, but none of this has stopped me from wanting the game on the only platform where 60 fps won't be much of a challenge to hit: PC. Tweaking settings you don't care as much about to juice the frame rate is much preferable over having to deal with a set "performance" mode or a glitch that could be patched out any day. A good PC version should be able to nicely scale up or down in performance based on your hardware setup, and Rockstar has shown that it can pull that off in the past with games like Red Dead Redemption 2 .
For a game as good as GTA 6—Chris says it's "(mostly) great" in his 100-hour impressions — you shouldn't have to deal with quirks that tarnish the experience. I'm not a Rockstar employee, I don't know what challenges a PC version introduces or why it wasn't prioritized for a simultaneous PC and console release, but I do know that a PC version likely won't have as many caveats when it comes to performance as it does on consoles. So, I'll deal with Rockstar's intended 30 fps cap until the moment I can boot up GTA 6 on my PC, and then forget that I ever had to endure the limits of the current console experience.
