Deborah Ann Woll said she felt " totally unbothered " by the small but vocal subset of gamers who were upset by the upcoming God of War: Laufey, and apparently she meant it—because today Amazon MGM Studios announced that she's going to play the same role in the live-action God of War series coming to Prime.
Just as in God of War: Laufey and its predecessor, God of War: Ragnarok, Woll—best known for playing Karen Page in Marvel's Daredevil, Defenders, and Punisher TV series, as well as a lengthy stint on True Blood as Jessica Hamby—will portray Faye, wife of Kratos and mother of Atreus.
"Faye’s abrupt passing sets in motion the events of God of War," the announcement says. "Along their journey, Kratos and Atreus discover secrets about Faye that make them wonder how well they truly knew her at all."
It's been a bumpy road for the God of War series. It was first reported in 2022, but started over from scratch two years later after the showrunner and executive producers quit. We got our first look at Ryan Hurst as Kratos earlier this year—not very impressive, but we all had the same initial impression of Henry Cavill as Geralt and that worked out well—but then Hurst had to be recast because of an on-set injury; Dave Bautista now has the lead role. Child actors Callum Vinson and Island Austin, who played Atreus and Thrud, were also recast .
God of War: Laufey is set to launch on May 20, 2027, but sadly is a PlayStation 5 exclusive, a state of affairs that seems likely to endure given Sony's recent strategy shift. The God of War live action series on Prime has been ordered for two seasons, but a release target hasn't been announced.

Obviously, massive spoilers follow for GTA 6 endings!
There are multiple endings to GTA 6 , and while we haven't experienced them all personally here at PC Gamer, the gaming community has been sharing them around for anyone curious about what they may have missed.
The ending you get depends on the choices you make during the final GTA 6 story mission , but also depends on how you handled Jason and Lucia's romance and criminal profiles throughout the game, so seeing every version of the ending would mean not just playing the ending multiple times, but having different playthroughs of the game altogether.
There are a couple of endings that I don't consider "different" from each other but do have some differences leading up to them, which I'll explain below. There may also be additional endings we haven't seen yet, so we may update this guide in the future.
GTA 6 endings on the bridge In the bridge endings, Jason and Lucia have defeated Mendez and his squad and gotten the hard drive back from Georgio's penthouse and escaped. They drive to Cal's place in Key Lento, but discover he has been compromised. They drive to the bridge, but the cops have set up a roadblock and have the couple trapped. Lucia wants to keep going, but Jason suggests they jump off the bridge and swim for it.
A choice comes up on the screen: "Swim For it" or "No Surrender."
Ending 1: No Surrender Jason and Lucia try to run the roadblock and are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, we see that their son Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children.

Have a strong relationship with Jason and Lucia Shoot Mendez Choose "No Surrender" on the bridge Ending 2: No Surrender + $2 million Jason and Lucia are shot to death by cops on the bridge. They die holding hands. In the credits, their lawyer, Abe, brings the money to Lucia's aunt. Tomas lives happily with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children in a much bigger house than the other No Surrender ending.

Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. They both exit the car without holding guns. Lucia jumps, but Jason doesn't jump and is arrested. Lucia signs a deal for immunity while Jason goes to prison. Lucia gets a job in a diner. Lucia takes Tomas to meet Jason in prison, but he can only see his son through a glass divider.

Shoot Mendez Choose "Swim for it" on the bridge Choose "Exit" on the bridge Ending 4: Swim for it + Don't Exit Jason and Lucia decide to jump off the bridge and swim for it. Jason exits the car with a gun, but Lucia changes her mind and stays in the car. The police open fire and Jason and Lucia are both shot to death. Tomas lives with Lucia's aunt, her husband, and their children.

The graphics in GTA 6 are so realistic that actual photos and videos are being mistaken as screenshots or clips from the game.
It feels like every social media platform is chock-full of posts about Rockstar’s latest release, which has cemented itself as the biggest entertainment launch of all time . For instance, a video taken from influencer India Love’s live stream sparked a swath of comments from viewers who had to do a double-take to make sure they weren’t watching a clip from GTA 6, partly owing to the lighting. pool.titulo: GTA 6 Praised for Its Accurate Portrayal of Felon Rehabilitation
pool.resumen: GTA 6 is receiving praise for its commentary on how hard it is for felons to start a life and the system that breeds crime.
pool.contenido:
GTA 6 is receiving praise for its commentary on how hard it is for felons to start a new life and the system that breeds crime.
In GTA 6, Jason and Lucia choose a life of crime in hopes of creating financial stability in their lives. Their goal isn't necessarily to get rich and buy flashy cars or a mansion, but so they can lay the foundation for their family. Although Jason runs drugs for a local crime boss, Lucia in particular is the one who really pushes them to take on more ambitious jobs. Some players felt that her decision-making at the start of the game was a bit reckless, given that she just got out of prison — but if you read her text messages, things begin to make a lot more sense.
Players realized that her parole officer had denied her petition to take a job at a local bar, one of her only options for employment because she knew someone who worked there that could vouch for her. Without that, her record as a convicted felon would make it difficult for employers to consider her for a position. Her PO also noted that she's overdue on paying court-ordered parole fees, which she can't pay because she doesn't have a job, putting her in a vicious cycle.
Lucia's willingness to get back into crime makes a lot more sense when you look at her texts with her PO and see that they denied her request to get a job but still wanted her to pay bills she has no money for https://t.co/HBfpsZEmz2
— Nikuo 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 (@MEATMAAAAN) November 23, 2026
This pushes Lucia to get involved with shady characters who turn her life with Jason upside down. A number of fans have praised this particular narrative beat, including some who have worked within this very system.
"As someone who worked as part of the system years ago, not as a PO but a case manager, this is wildly accurate to real life," said X user Mgs2master . "Rockstar did their homework here."
"GTA 6 is brave enough to try and educate the player on how desperation can drive you to crime through how it incorporates gameplay mechanics into the story," said one player . "It's genuinely one of the best uses of ludonarrative I’ve ever seen, period. I am floored."
"As someone who's had family that has had to go through this s**t, it's genuinely not satirical," said another user . "This is straight up just what happens. The system is designed to funnel criminals back into crime by denying them opportunities needed to rehabilitate themselves to keep prisons full."
Another person noted that this system blocks people out of having a reasonable chance of developing a good life: "The US has a recidivism problem because once you have a felony you're essentially locked out of a good chunk of employment and housing stuff, and then these orgs act surprised when people go back to crime. The econ equivalent of kicking people while they're down."
Rockstar Games writer Rupert Humphries told Love Magazine earlier this year that the "American Dream" as we know it has scaled down for many people with each passing GTA game. Now, people just want a foundation to live and build a family, but the state of the world has made that increasingly unattainable, and in the case of GTA 6, it leads to the characters taking matters into their own hands.
"Some would say the American Dream collapsed a long time ago," said Humphries. "With GTA 4, we told an immigrant’s story that was supposed to be a kind of hollow commentary on the illusion of America as a land of opportunity, and then we sort of doubled down on that with the cynicism of GTA 5. Maybe the American Dream is more modest now. It’s a house for your family and your loans paid off instead of wild success — but maybe today, that is just as out of reach for the average person. Miami and Southern Florida are a particular front line for this battle between astronomical wealth and unbounded ambition, creating a pressure cooker for all kinds of insanity."
Of course, GTA 6 is still fiction and isn't an endorsement of real crime, despite how much some people would like you to believe otherwise . It's more so putting two charcaters in these circumstances and seeing how they react to the cards they're dealt. There also wouldn't be much of a game if Lucia decided to just spend the rest of her days scrounging for minimum wage work, after all.
GTA 6 has been a roaring success so far, generating over $3.79 billion in revenue in its first 24 hours with over 32.5 million copies sold in pre-sales alone. The game is also a critical smash hit, tying with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the best reviewed video game in history on Metacritic. IGN gave GTA 6 a 10 out of 10 , praising it for its depth and detail.
"Exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered, GTA 6 has not stopped astonishing me since I started it," reads an excerpt from the review. "I regularly find myself in love with video games, but it’s extraordinarily rare that I find myself in complete awe of them. Put simply, Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played."

pool.titulo: GTA 6 Players Are Upset Its New Train Can Actually Be Stopped After Spending 13 Years With the Unstoppable GTA 5 Train
pool.resumen: GTA 5's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop GTA 6's train – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.
pool.contenido:
GTA 5 's unstoppable train has been a meme for a decade, so naturally, players wasted no time trying to stop the one in GTA 6 – but they were sad to find out that it wasn't all that hard to do.
What better way to spend the early days of a project that Rockstar Games fans waited 13 years for than to immediately do the same thing they've already been doing? As players were dropped into the south end of Leonida, many immediately took Jason as far as they could just to find a train to stand in front of.
There is, indeed, a new train screeching over the tracks surrounding Vice City, but there's a problem – it has no aura.
Finally, the train in GTA 6 has come to stop 😭😭😭😭 https://t.co/ly0JOJ0Mb0

So sánh tàu hỏa đối đầu với các phương tiện trong GTA5 vs GTA6 vs PDR2 https://t.co/M4CwCbgokx
— Troy Ah Keith (@TroyAhKeith) November 23, 2026
If you're one of the few people who hasn't picked up GTA 5 since it launched in 2013, you still may have heard about its unstoppable train. The iconic black, yellow, and white locomotive patrols Los Santos and has for years, and unlike just about every other vehicle in the game, there's nothing Michael, Franklin, or Trevor can do to stop it.
Dumb trucks, C4, planes, rows of cars – you name it. No one has ever been able to get GTA 5's train to budge. After 13 years of trying, it's become a meme on the internet to try and move the train, resulting in countless videos that have cropped up from those seeking to test its mettle (and farm a bit of engagement on social media).
Naturally, GTA 6 presented an updated take on the opportunity when players discovered its train. Unfortunately, Rockstar's commitment to realism means moving the new locomotive isn't just possible; it's actually kind of easy. Crash into it with a dump truck? Works like a charm. Park an excavator in its path? Stops it in its tracks. Raise a bridge? Completely detailed. Rockstar's new, smarter NPCs even have the brains to pull the brakes when they see a person simply standing in their way.
This is where we get into the argument that has plagued Rockstar both inside and outside of the studio for years: When is a game too realistic? Judging by GTA 6's record-breaking earnings and all-time great reviews , it seems the developers' new playground struck a nice balance between being grounded and goofy. Of course, that hasn't stopped a small section of players from being upset that Leonida plays by many of the same rules that we do in the real world.
After GTA 5's train spent more than a decade as the running champ of viral videos to come out of Los Santos, players aren't ready to let GTA 5's train go. In fact, some have began to almost deify the 2013 locomotive, creating fan edits showing the last train as the superior vehicle in the locomotive power-scaling battle.
"Yeah, this and the 'No first-person mode' are the biggest downsides for me," one X/Twitter user said .

pool.titulo: The Rushed Rings of Power Episode Release Schedule Is Likely Thanks to Amazon's Black Friday Sale Strategy
pool.contenido:
Prime Video's The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3 wraps up this Wednesday with its final two episodes. It's a surprisingly condensed release schedule for a billion-dollar TV series. Both Seasons 1 and 2 of the series were extended into more strung-out episode drops, so why is Amazon seemingly rushing this one?
Well, while we don't have confirmation from Amazon directly, the answer seems to be pretty obvious: Black Friday . The Rings of Power is Amazon's biggest series and is presumably a significant draw to get people to sign up for an Amazon Prime membership just in time for the biggest shopping holiday of the year.
The Rings of Power episode release schedules at a glance Season 1 - September 1 - October 14 (7 weeks) Season 2 - August 19 - October 3 (6 weeks) Season 3 - November 11 - 25 (3 weeks) 2026 marks the first time new episodes of The Rings of Power started dropping in November, as both previous seasons kicked off near the beginning of September. If you consider this change in release timing in terms of Amazon's eCommerce business, the reason for this seems rooted in the service's free trial . New subscribers can get an Amazon Prime membership for free for 30 days, and both the premiere and the finale of the Prime Video LOTR show fit neatly in that window.
There's certainly nothing wrong with Amazon manipulating its Prime Video release schedule to aid the retail part of its business, assuming that is what is happening here. After all, the main draw of an Amazon Prime membership is that you get a streaming service and all of the Prime shopping benefits that come with it. The fact that Amazon is choosing to do this for the first time with Season 3 is what makes it so interesting.
Prime Video is one of the biggest streaming services out there right now, but it's been a part of their service since 2011. While you can actually get a Prime Video subscription without getting an Amazon Prime membership, the free trial is only available for the full shopping subscription. So it's these big original shows like Rings of Power and Fallout that most likely drive high rates of free trial sign-ups to the service every year. For the folks who are only grabbing the free trial to watch the show and then cancelling after binge-watching, however, there's only a small window of time in which Amazon has to convince them to continue on with their subscription.
With the streaming services becoming more and more expensive every year, this shift in Amazon's release schedule feels like a big deal. I myself have cancelled and renewed several streaming subscriptions this year based on the new shows coming out. I have very little time to watch TV in my week, so it's become harder for me to justify paying a monthly fee for something I'm not actively using. Amazon appears to be making an effort to adjust to this sort of mentality by aligning the rest of its subscription benefits with its biggest TV release of the year. We won't see how well this strategy works out for them this year until Amazon reveals its Q4 revenue numbers, but I have a feeling this is only the beginning of a much larger shift in streaming service strategy moving forward.

pool.titulo: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Will Have to Testify Publicly Before US Senate
pool.resumen: Earlier today, Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, after two weeks of scandals involving multiple affairs and a suspected spy. But while he's back in the pilot's seat, Huang's problems aren't over, and he's been summoned to testify in front of the US Senate.
pool.contenido:
Earlier today, Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO , after two weeks of scandals involving multiple affairs and a suspected spy. Although he's back in the pilot's seat, Huang's problems aren't over, as he's been summoned to testify in front of the U.S. Senate.
Jensen Huang has been summoned to testify in front of the Senate's Banking Committee on December 3, according to Bloomberg . The hearing was announced by the committee's chairman, Tim Scott, and will focus on oversight of U.S. export controls. That comes just a week after Nvidia announced that it would be establishing a National Security and Export Control Committee last week .
Huang's appearance in front of the Banking Committee is only the latest hearing that's been announced. Huang is also scheduled to appear in front of three House committees in two closed-doors meetings on December 1 and December 2 . While those congressional hearings will be closed to the public, they will be transcribed, and will likely also be covering Nvidia's adherance to U.S. export controls.
But while Huang will now have to testify in front of both houses of Congress, his reinstatement came after President Donald Trump intervened on his behalf . In Nvidia's own statement about the CEO's return, it said, "In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk." It turns out that input came from President Trump, who called the board and gave "reassurances" that Huang's return wouldn't pose a national security risk.
While the President acted to have Huang reinstated, plenty of representatives from both parties have demanded answers on social media. Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren posted , saying, "This reckless decision to bring back Jensen Huang does not change the fact that Huang and NVIDIA still owe Congress answers. The Trump Administration needs to explain what 'input' was given and by which senior officials to support Huang’s reinstatement."
At the same time, Republican Senator John Curtis posted, "Nvidia’s board says it relied on input from senior U.S. officials to conclude that bringing Jensen Huang back posed no national security risk. I have some questions. Who in our government weighed in? What did they tell the board? And on what basis did the board conclude there was no risk?"
While this scandal built up steam in the background for months, it really exploded two weeks ago, when Huang admitted to an affair that kicked off an internal investigation into his conduct . He resigned just a few days later , and even though the board came out and said Huang wouldn't be reinstated , he reclaimed his office earlier today.

pool.titulo: The Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer Has Us Even More Confused About Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter
pool.resumen: We've been confused about Steve Rogers and Peggy Carter ever since Avengers: Endgame, and the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday only raises further questions.
pool.contenido:
In case you’re currently trapped in a deep, dark, GTA-shaped hole, the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday has landed . This new trailer doesn’t necessarily reveal a lot about the plot of the film we didn’t already know, but it does give us a closer glimpse of two characters who are clearly going to be a big focus: Chris Evans’ Steve Rogers and Hayley Atwell’s Peggy Carter. In fact, it’s starting to look as though Steve is the main character of this massive ensemble movie.
That’s not necessarily a bad thing, especially for fans who have struggled to connect with the more recent superhero additions to the MCU. But it does highlight a problem the MCU has faced since Avengers: Endgame hit theaters back in 2019. Nothing about the strange new existence of Steve and Peggy makes much sense. Let’s try to break it down.
Avengers: Endgame’s Questionable Ending We have so many questions surrounding the fates of Steve and Peggy after the Infinity Saga wrapped, and many of them have been burning since the final moments of Endgame. In case you’ve forgotten, Endgame wraps with Steve gathering the Infinity Stones and embarking on a quest to return them to their rightful points in time and space. We never see that quest play out (not even the surely awkward reunion between Steve and Red Skull on Vormir). Instead, we quickly realize that Steve never had any intention of returning from that final mission.
At that point, a much older and happier Steve shows up to pass the Captain America mantle to Anthony Mackie’s Sam Wilson. This version of Steve has clearly been living out a quiet life in the MCU for decades, enjoying the civilian life he was robbed of after becoming Cap. In the film’s final scene, it’s revealed that Steve’s final stop on his Infinity Stone quest was to reunite with Peggy in the 1950s, allowing them to finally share that long-awaited dance.
It’s a heartwarming ending, to be sure, but also one that raises a lot of weird questions. Did Steve really run off and retire in the past? How did no one ever notice Captain America hanging around in a time when he’s believed to be a dead war hero?
The questions only get more pressing the further you dig into this ending. As far as we’re aware, Peggy married a man in the 1950s and had children with him. Did Steve just erase all that from existence with his choice? Where was he at Peggy’s funeral in 2016’s Captain America: Civil War? And what about all the metahuman and alien-related incidents that have unfolded over the years? Did Steve just sit out those battles when he could have been helping?
However much the former Cap deserves some peace and contentment, it’s hard to understand how his choice to go back and be with Peggy doesn’t completely throw the MCU’s timeline out of whack. But the same could be said for the Avengers’ actions in Endgame as a whole. We still don’t fully understand the rules and mechanics of time travel in the MCU. Based on the many conflicting answers the Russo Bros. and others have given over the years, we’re not convinced they do, either. And now that we’ve plunged headlong into the Multiverse Saga, things are only becoming more confusing.
Avengers: Doomsday’s Steve Rogers Confusion It seems as though Marvel is making at least some effort to address these lingering questions and the general uncertainty surrounding Steve and Peggy with the climax of the Multiverse Saga. The recently released Avengers Endgame: Encore ends with an extended version of that final Steve/Peggy scene . This time, their tender dance is interrupted by the arrival of Tom Hiddleston’s Loki. Specifically, this is the alternate 2012 version of Loki who partnered up with the Time Variance Authority.
That’s a good start. Thanks to his adventures with the TVA, Loki has a pretty firm grasp on what is and isn’t permissible when it comes to time travel and multiversal shenanigans. We’re not clear on whether this version of Loki is from after the series finale of the show ( when he took his place on the throne of the multiverse ), or if he’s coming from some point during the middle of the series. But either way, he’s clearly there to put the kibosh on Steve’s plan to f*** up the timeline.
Or is he? It sure doesn’t look as though Loki forces Steve to return to his rightful time and place. Instead, the final trailer seems to suggest that the two lovers move house and set up a new life elsewhere. We’re guessing that elsewhere is Earth-828, aka The Fantastic Four: First Steps universe. Presumably, the idea is that Steve can live quietly in a world that has no Captain America to begin with.
Whatever the case, Steve and Peggy maintain their new life long enough to raise a preteen son. Only at that point do the FF finally take notice of a family who by all rights should not exist in their world.
Loki’s intervention eases some of the immediate questions raised by Steve’s actions in Endgame, but it raises new ones in their place. Loki’s intervention eases some of the immediate questions raised by Steve’s actions in Endgame, but it raises new ones in their place. Why is Loki so willing to help Steve and Peggy cheat the rules when the TVA is notoriously pretty rigid about upholding the natural order of things? Why does booting these two to a different universe not violate the organization’s mandate, especially after everything we saw in 2024’s Deadpool & Wolverine and all that Anchor Being business ? At what point does the elderly Steve return to his home universe?
But what really has us confused is the implication that Peggy now disappeared from the MCU in the 1950s. She’s supposed to be a very important figure post-WWII. She was instrumental in the founding of S.H.I.E.L.D. and worked with heroes like Michael Douglas’ Hank Pym. Is all of that just erased now, along with Peggy’s previous marriage? How does that not have a cascading ripple effect across the MCU? And how does the scene in Endgame where Steve travels back and sees Peggy at Camp LeHigh work now?

pool.resumen:
Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming, making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a […]
The post How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play appeared first on XBOX Wire .
pool.contenido:
Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space.
Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming.
You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally.
Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required):
How to Start Playing Grand Theft Auto VI via the Cloud
To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps:
From your XBOX Wireless Controller, press the XBOX button to open the guide, then search for Grand Theft Auto VI
Select the “ Manage ” button and then “ See in Microsoft Store ”
From the Store listing, select “ Play With Cloud ”
When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality.
How To Start Playing Grand Theft Auto VI via Remote Play
Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it:
From your XBOX Series X|S, go to Settings -> Devices & connections -> Remote features , and then check the box to “ Enable remote features ”
Optional : Select “Test remote play” from this same menu to get a sense of the quality you can expect from your connection.
Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices:
Play from mobile device : From your browser go to play.xbox.com/remoteplay and select the console you want to connect to and select “Remote Play on This Device.”
Play from PC or XBOX ROG Ally: Open the XBOX on PC app, click on your profile icon in the top right, go to “ Accessories & remote play ,” and select “ Remote play ” from the console to play from.
Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

pool.titulo: Thank you for making Grand Theft Auto VI the biggest launch in PlayStation history
pool.resumen: After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI. It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida. Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the […]
pool.contenido:
After a long wait, players finally have had the chance to jump into Grand Theft Auto VI . It’s been amazing to see the PlayStation community around the world begin their adventures in the state of Leonida.
Whether you’ve been counting down the days to return to the streets of Vice City or you’re experiencing the Grand Theft Auto series for the very first time, we want to take a moment to say: thank you. The excitement and passion of the community have made this a truly special moment for all of us.
Celebrating a historic launch
The launch of GTAVI marks an extraordinary moment for gaming and entertainment, becoming the biggest game launch in PlayStation history, across three decades and five console generations. More than 39 million unique players have experienced Jason and Lucia’s story in Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5.
The PlayStation community came together in a big way to experience Grand Theft Auto VI during its launch and opening weekend. Here are a few highlights from the launch window ending November 22, 2026*:
GTAVI set a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any game on PlayStation , surpassing previous records across multiplayer, free-to-play, and single-player titles.
Across PS5, players cumulatively logged an incredible 683 million hours of gameplay in GTAVI , reflecting the enthusiasm of the PlayStation community. Each player has spent an average of 17.4 hours exploring the state of Leonida during the game’s opening days.
The PlayStation community has grown, as we saw the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the console’s launch, outside of end-of-year holidays. Since its launch, GTAVI was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles.
These are just a few ways we’ve seen our PlayStation community come together around this incredible moment in gaming, and we’re excited to see how you continue to build and share new memories and experiences in the months ahead.
Thank you for being part of this moment
Finally, we want to congratulate our partners at Rockstar Games for bringing this extraordinary game to players around the world and continuing a partnership with PlayStation that stretches back to Grand Theft Auto III on PlayStation 2. With GTAVI, we worked to bring the best experience on PS5 and gave players a memorable way to commemorate the game with two special limited-edition DualSense wireless controllers inspired by Vice City. We also celebrated the launch with live events including Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival in Miami this past weekend.
And to our PlayStation community, thank you for your continued passion and support, and for choosing to experience GTAVI on PS5 . It’s your enthusiasm that make moments like these so meaningful for all of us.
We can’t wait to see where your adventures in Leonida take you next!
*All figures are based on SIE internal data collected from November 19, 2026, to November 22, 2026

pool.titulo: Trump claims credit for Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia, posts meme depicting Huang holding up a bra victoriously
pool.resumen: US politicians on both sides of the aisle are reeling.
pool.contenido:
US President Donald Trump told CNBC on Monday that he personally "convinced" the Nvidia board to reinstate Jensen Huang .
Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO a little under two weeks ago after admitting to an extramarital affair with Alice Huang (no relation), who formerly controlled Singaporean tech company Megaspeed International and has been the subject of US national security concerns related to AI chip exports to China.
Following the admission, as well as reports of two other affairs with Nvidia employees, Huang resigned as Nvidia president, CEO, and board member. Last week, amid calls for Huang's return from tech CEOs and investors, the Nvidia board said firmly that it would not reinstate him.
Cue the It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia title card: The gang reinstated him. On Monday, the Nvidia board said that it had "voted unanimously" to bring Huang back after receiving "input from senior levels of the United States government." Nvidia shares shot up 31.48% during Monday's trading.
Trump has taken credit for the change of heart. "I made the deal," he told CNBC. The President also posted a congratulatory AI-generated image depicting Huang as himself surviving an attempted assassination while holding up a red bra victoriously.
The news of Huang's reinstatement prompted a flurry of responses from US congressmembers on Monday.
"President Trump's direct involvement with Nvidia’s decision to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang raises serious national security and corruption questions. We must investigate these actions," said California Democratic congressman Robert Garcia in a statement . "No president who has invested in a private company should be involved in their board decisions. Congress must come together in swift bipartisan action and demand answers immediately."
It hasn't just been Democrats criticizing Huang's reinstatement.
"Jensen Huang had multiple affairs including with subordinates and an alleged Chinese spy. His own board described his behavior as lacking 'candor,'" said Republican senator Pete Ricketts of Nebraska. "I've served on a public company board. His behavior does not support reinstatement."
"The risk of extortion by a Chinese asset who's been banned by Singapore is risk enough to not rehire Huang," said North Dakota Republican Kevin Cramer. "The worst part of this is what we may never know. Congress should immediately pass the strictest export controls possible. I hope it’s not too late."
Huang is set to testify before the US Senate next Thursday, December 3.

pool.titulo: Save Up to $1,100 Off the 2026 65" Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED Ultimate Gaming TVs for Black Friday
pool.resumen: RGB Mini-LED tech boasts richer colors, a brighter picture, and wider viewing angles than ever before.
pool.contenido:
Last year, Hisense pioneered the first RGB Mini-LED TV with its 116UX model. Granted it was only available as a massive 116" screen that retailed for $20,000. In 2026, Hisense released its second generation RGB Mini-LED tech at a much more affordable price point with its UR-series lineup. For Black Friday, you can get it for even less. Best Buy has just discounted the 65" Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED TV from $2,000 all the way down to $899.99 and the 75" model from $2,500 down to $1399.99, both with free delivery. These are the lowest prices since launch and beats previous lows by $200.
The Hisense UR8 RGB Mini-LED TV Gives OLED a Run for Its Money
RGB Mini-LED is essentially the next generation evolution of Mini-LED technology. Traditional mini-LED TVs consist of an array of blue LED that are passed through RGB filters to produced the desired color. RGB Mini-LED TVs use red, green, and blue LEDs instead of just blue, which means the pixels no longer need filters to produce the desired color. The result is more accurate color reproduction, less blooming and, most importantly, a wider color gamut. In fact, the color gamut of RGB Mini-LED surpasses that of OLEDs, since current-generation OLEDs also use color filters combined with blue OLEDs. How does that translate in the real world? It means that you see richer, more accurate colors, smoother gradients and less banding than even OLEDs, especially in 4K HDR content.
RGB Mini-LED TVs have several other features that out-class standard Mini-LEDs. They're brighter (far brighter than OLED TVs), making them perfect for daytime watching in bright rooms with little light control. They offer much better viewing angles, which means everyone you're hosting will enjoy the game wherever they're positioned around the TV. Gamers will benefit from this TV as well. The Hisense UR8 boasts a 180Hz native refresh rate, the highest I've ever seen for a TV, with HDMI 2.1 inputs that will pair seamlessly with a PlayStation 5 console for seamlessly running games in 4K.

pool.titulo: GTA 6 Was Biggest Launch in PlayStation History
pool.resumen: Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.
pool.contenido:
Now that the dust has somewhat settled after the avalanche that was the launch of GTA 6, PlayStation has revealed some of its stats from the game, revealing that this was the single largest game release in PlayStation history.
PlayStation’s November 23 blog post states that more than 39 million unique players have played the game on the PlayStation 5, setting a new record for the highest number of concurrent players for any PlayStation game. This beats out other records for multiplayer games, single-player games, and perhaps most astonishingly, even free-to-play titles.
On top of that, GTA 6 players logged a total of 683 million hours played in the game, with the average player spending an estimated 17.4 hours sticking up virtual pawn shops and stealing NPC’s cars during its first few days.
What’s more impressive is the sheer amount of people who purchased PS5s specifically to play GTA 6. PlayStation’s blog says it saw the “largest number of newly-connected PS5 consoles on a single day” since the console’s launch in November 2020, not counting end-of-year holidays like Christmas. Since GTA 6’s launch, it was the first game played on 70% of these new consoles.
GTA 6 has, perhaps unsurprisingly, broken a slew of big records. The most prominent of these is its status as the biggest entertainment launch of all time, with Rockstar reporting that the game earned $3.79 billion in its first 24 hours.
On top of this, internet provider Comcast said that GTA 6’s launch day was its highest-traffic day ever , with 24% of all its internet traffic during peak times coming from users downloading and playing Rockstar’s latest offering. Xbox had its own big records, too; Xfinity, which is under the Comcast umbrella, said GTA 6 increased the internet traffic on Xbox consoles by four times the normal amount this November.
People are still making new discoveries in this game, and there’s bound to be many more that pop up over the next few months. GTA 6 is up for eight awards at The Game Awards and has enjoyed massive critical reception, with IGN scoring it a glowing 10 out of 10 — the title of ‘Masterpiece.’ Reviewer Luke Reilly praised the game for being “exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered,” saying “Grand Theft Auto 6 is the single most impressive video game I have ever played.”
It’s unlikely that we see a game release as big as this one, with such a massive cultural impact, ever again. Rockstar certainly set a new standard for the industry with this one, to the point where many users aren’t sure if a photo they see online is from the real world or from the game .

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .

pool.titulo: Call of Duty's Player Count Dropped by Over 40% Following GTA 6's Release, According to Analysts
pool.resumen: A new report claims that Call of Duty saw an over 40% drop in players following GTA 6's release.
pool.contenido:
A new report claims that Call of Duty saw an over 40% drop in players following GTA 6's release.
We've known all year long that Rockstar Games was going to dominate the final two months of 2026 thanks to the release of GTA 6. It's why a lot of publishers moved their games either into 2027 or pushed them up to September to steer clear of the blast radius. Call of Duty, however, releases on an annual cycle around October or November, which means Modern Warfare 4's post-launch plans were beginning right around the time of GTA 6's launch.
According to Alinea Analytics, it appears that Call of Duty lost almost half of its player base during GTA 6's record-breaking launch weekend . The Call of Duty app (which consists of Warzone, Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4) saw a 42% drop across platforms, taking the overall daily player count from 7.6 million users to 4.4 million users. There's likely a lot of crossover between GTA and Call of Duty's audiences, so it's no surprise to see a drop in players, but nearly half clearly highlights just how much of an event GTA 6 is.
Call of Duty app (MW4, Warzone, and BO7) lost 42% of players following GTA 6's launch, down from 7.6M daily active users to 4.4M
PS5 saw the biggest drop off out of all platforms with 44% decline in players, per Alinea Analytics https://t.co/cARXye3Ahs
— CharlieIntel (@charlieINTEL) November 23, 2026
Earlier this fall, Activision chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl stated that he believed GTA 6 would actually help Call of Duty , as the open-world crime epic would drive more attention toward gaming as a whole. People are buying new consoles or dusting off old ones to play this game, so in theory, they will turn their attention toward other titles once they are done with GTA. Whether that title is Call of Duty remains to be seen, but currently, it appears to only be hurting the series in the immediate short term. Things will probably bounce back up, but it'll be interesting to see how many people return.
This also may not be the last time Call of Duty takes a hit from GTA 6. There are expected to be at least two more big beats or launches for this game, with the PC release rumored for an early 2027 release . However, the even bigger moment will come in the form in the inevitable online mode. Rockstar hasn't talked about its plans for GTA 6's online offerings yet, but it's highly speculated to release sometime next year . If it drops in the summer, it may not hurt Call of Duty a ton since that is the period where the most hardcore fans are still grinding away on the game.
But if GTA 6 Online dropped next fall, around October or November, it could put Call of Duty in a really difficult position. It'll be an interesting story to follow, but Call of Duty has been battling intense competition for two straight years now thanks to Battlefield 6 in 2025 and GTA 6 this year. Maybe it can contend next year, but the jury is still out.

pool.titulo: Ted Lasso Renewed for Season 5 on Apple TV
pool.resumen: Ted Lasso is coming back to Apple TV for a fifth season, with production set to begin in April 2027.
pool.contenido:
Ted Lasso is coming back to Apple TV for a fifth season, with production set to begin in April 2027.
Apple TV’s beloved comedy series is coming back for another season, and it’s possible that there’s more in store. As pointed out by Variety , Jackson Sudeikis — who will return as both executive producer and star of the show — said he “would like to” continue the project through a sixth season in an October episode of Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso.
“Yeah, I just don’t know,” he told the host when asked about the topic, clarifying that he wasn’t holding anything back “intentionally.” “We haven’t started a writers’ room or anything like that,” he added.
For now, we know that Season 5 is in the bag, but this isn’t a huge surprise. In fact, it was almost a given, seeing how Season 4 was Apple TV’s biggest launch in the platform’s history. Its premiere garnered an astonishing 296.6 million minutes watched , proving the audience’s interest even after its initial storyline wrapped up at the end of Season 3.
Now, Ted’s on a new mission: to coach a women’s football team. The newly formed second-division team, the Lady Greyhounds, take Ted on a parallel journey with new obstacles, primarily navigating the environment of women’s athletics and the unique challenges that come with it.
Ted Lasso has been a hugely successful show, both among fans and critics alike. We at IGN scored its first season a glowing 9 out of 10 , calling it a “relentlessly optimistic and disarmingly charming comedy” that was sorely needed when it was released back in 2020. And while our review of the Season 4 premiere was comparatively softer , it certainly resonated with audiences enough to warrant a continuation of its new storyline.
For those who are unfamiliar with the show, it follows the kind, optimistic Ted Lasso, an American college football coach who gets hired to help a struggling English football league whose owner secretly hopes it fails. It’s a delightful watch, and a premise that has continued to prove sorely sought-after in the six years since its initial release.
Ted Lasso streams exclusively on Apple TV . For more shows streaming on the service, you can check out every series that’s making its way to the platform this November , which includes movies and shows like 12 12 12, Way of the Warrior Kid, and Stick Season 2.

pool.titulo: GTA 6's Best Easter Egg Is a Classic Tom Cruise Crime-Thriller You Can Stream For Free
pool.resumen: A GTA 6 taxi encounter echoes Michael Mann’s Collateral, starring Tom Cruise and Jamie Foxx. Watch it free on Pluto TV or stream it on Paramount Plus.
pool.contenido: One of Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s strangest random encounters occurs when you’re offering taxi services, and a man with a beard wearing a dark suit and sunglasses climbs into the backseat with a gun. This can happen if you’re playing as either Jason or Lucia, but both scenes play out the same way: The man wants you to run a red light, ignore phone calls, and drive him to Harborside Park in Vice Beach. He also sounds an awful lot like Tom Cruise, with a calm but forceful demeanor that seems almost sociopathic . Several clips of the sequence have already hit the internet, and to many people, it’s an obvious nod to Collateral , Michael Mann’s 2004 thriller about a hitman who takes a cab driver hostage.

Your instinct is to just go with your gut; Silent Hill 2 is what you came here for, after all. But something’s telling you otherwise. Maybe it’s the store clerk going on about its open-world premise, or the name itself that strikes a chord within you. Whatever reason incites it, you make the ultimate decision. pool.titulo: Crear algunos de los mejores JRPG de la historia tiene un precio. Atlus avisa sobre sus planes con Persona, y yo sólo espero que no pierdan su esencia
pool.resumen:
Esta semana, quizá por la falta de información sobre Persona 6 , la siguiente entrega de la saga, recibíamos con cierto optimismo las declaraciones de Kazuhisa Wada, productor general del P-Studio, que afirmaba algo que ya sabíamos: que "Persona 6 no es el final" (¿cómo lo va a ser, con el éxito que tiene en la actualidad?) y, quizá más interesante, que "estamos buscando la forma de que los jugadores no tengan que esperar tanto tiempo" al siguiente juego como lo han hecho en otras entregas.
Estas últimas declaraciones son interesantes porque dentro de esa nueva forma no puede estar aderezar el calendario con remakes y spin-offs, ya que esto es algo que ya se estaba haciendo, con los lanzamientos de juegos como Persona 5 Tactica , Persona 5 Strikers y los remakes de Persona 3 Reload y Persona 4 Revival . Todo sin contar que, entre medias, también tuvimos Metaphor: ReFantazio . Tiene que referirse, por tanto, a acelerar la saga principal . Que no pasen ocho años desde la llegada de un juego numerado y el siguiente.
El precio de la perfección
La cuestión es: ¿es esto viable? Justo en el último post del Botón de Pausa hablaba de las razones por las que las secuelas pueden tardar tanto

pool.titulo: James Cameron’s Sci-Fi Sequel Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed from Netflix
pool.resumen: James Cameron’s 1986 film Aliens is about to leave Netflix. Watch is and relive the epicfinal battle with the alien queen
pool.contenido: In an action movie, there’s nothing worse than an underwhelming final battle. While Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings was one of the best post- Avengers: Endgame movies of the Marvel Cinematic Universe , its final battle became a disconnected CGI fest that was hard to follow. For Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Secret of the Ooze , the sequel’s fun energy was undermined when a mutated Shredder died after collapsing a dock onto himself without a fight ever even starting.
